title: elymus thoroldianus
intro: Elymus thoroldianus, commonly known as Thorold's wheat-grass or Tibetan wheat-grass, is a type of grass species belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and enhancing immune function. The therapeutic actions of Elymus thoroldianus are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic properties, which can help to alleviate stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Elymus thoroldianus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
